name: Alien Gambit
description: Explosive 5.Ng5 and 6.Nxf7! Knight sacrifice against the Caro-Kann Defense, dragging Black's King into the center.

root.blurb: Open with the King's pawn and invite Black's Caro-Kann Defense.
